description: Ben Yusuf Tamer elektronik ve Uzay ile çok merakım var. Ben tek kişiyim. Daha çok tasarımla ilgili bir proje olacak.
summary: A moon landing navigator that can transmit depth and altitude, temperature, light and shadow on the lunar surface, landing intensity and a 3D map of the moon to the earth with the satellites it is connected to in the finest detail. Through the website it is connected to, it can convey data about the moon to people. The website's artificial intelligence can find the most efficient landing site using data from Naviluna.
details: Naviluna transmits surface data collected from the Moon to Earth via the satellites it is connected to and makes it available to people through the website it is connected to. This project enables the fastest transmission of data from the Moon to Earth, down to the finest details. In this project, everything except creating Python code for the website with artificial intelligence support is the product of intelligence and wisdom.
